svg.aria-label: loops workflow graph: a ticket from GitHub, GitLab, Jira or Linear (MCP), plain text, or a backlog lane goes through intake, research, plan, implement, qa, product and reflect. Each phase holds its agents and the tools and services they use, and ends in a gate. Failed plans, claims and ACs are sent back. ai-memory is read at intake and written at reflect; hooks log every step to events.jsonl.
svg.title: loops workflow graph
